parts.text:
Experiment 1
Use a measuring cylinder to pour 25 cm of distilled water into the polystyrene cup. Support the
cup by putting it into the 250 cm beaker. Measure the temperature of the water and record it
in the table below.
Add all of solid M to the water, start the timer and stir the solution with the thermometer.
Measure the temperature of the solution every 30 seconds for three minutes. Record your
results in the table. At the end of the experiment, pour about 4 cm of the solution into a test-
tube for Experiment 3.
